_comment: PERSISTENT remap exclusion list. Read by scripts/konspekt-remap-plan.mjs, which marks
any matching document status='EXCLUDED' BEFORE it proposes anything. That status is not
one of the auto-apply classes in konspekt-remap-autoapply.mjs, so an unattended run puts
these rows in 'held back' and can never re-file them.
This exists because a document deliberately reverted to UNSORTED is indistinguishable,
to the planner, from one that was never filed — it would happily re-propose the exact
filing a human just undid. Match is by documentId first, folder second (documentId is
the surer key; folder survives a re-ingest that changes the id).
To retire an entry: delete it. Do not add entries for rows that are merely uncertain —
uncertainty is already handled by the INVALID_TRIPLE / NO_METADATA hold classes.

excluded.reason: Filed medicina/medicina/Клинична токсикология on a konspekt tie of MEDIUM 0.486. The inverse lookup — this book's own title against the 527 konspekt titles — scores 0.318, below the 0.45 MEDIUM floor, so the filing does not survive the reverse test. Deliberately returned to the UNSORTED placeholder; must stay there until a human assigns a subject.
